game.title: Lies of P
game.blurb: Soulslike action RPG inspired by Pinocchio, from Round8 Studio, released 2023-09-19. RAWG average playtime: 27 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: No StrategyWiki page under this title. lies-of-p.fandom.com answers the API, with about 96 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 25 of 53 Steam achievements are hidden; most are named after bosses or endings and sit in the main story chapter. The 5 visible achievements about the Forgotten Time, its cipher machines and further P-Organ upgrades go to an Overture expansion chapter; about 6 hidden boss-style achievements with low unlock rates (around 15 to 19 percent, such as The Rose's Memory) may also belong to Overture but were left in the main story chapter and need checking.
